summary.en: A thread is the durable unit; turns and items describe work within it. Local and hosted conversations have different execution paths.
summary.zh: 会话是持久单元，轮次和条目描述其中的工作。本地与托管对话具有不同执行路径。

summary.en: Review, terminal, files, browser and side chat live alongside an active conversation. A panel is a UI surface, not an executor.
summary.zh: 审阅、终端、文件、浏览器和侧聊位于活动会话旁侧。面板是界面，并不等同于执行方。

summary.en: Window orchestration and native bridges connect the web-rendered interface to the operating system and subprocesses.
summary.zh: 窗口编排与原生桥将 Web 界面连接到操作系统和子进程。

summary.en: Tasks, agents and schedules have cloud-facing interfaces in the bundle. A captured destination does not prove its full workflow was exercised.
summary.zh: 发行包包含面向云端的任务、Agent 和计划接口。已截取目的地并不表示完整工作流已被验证。

summary.en: Settings combines protocol configuration, account services and OS permissions. Trace each setting to its own boundary.
summary.zh: 设置将协议配置、账号服务与系统权限汇聚在一起，每一项仍有自己的实现边界。

summary.en: The protocol defines thread, turn and item operations. Conversation service paths are grouped alongside them as an analytical comparison, not proof that local threads depend on those paths.
summary.zh: 协议定义会话、轮次和条目操作。conversation 服务路径在分析中与其并列，不构成本地会话依赖这些路径的证据。

summary.en: Core-to-client requests include approvals, user input and attestation. The direction identifies the party expected to answer; it does not establish which UI was displayed.
summary.zh: 内核到客户端的请求包括审批、用户输入和证明。方向标识应答方，不证明展示过哪种 UI。

summary.en: Command and process operations are declared by the core. Platform-specific or absent bundle literals remain visible in the inventory.
summary.zh: 内核声明命令与进程操作。平台专属方法及未命中包内字面量的方法仍保留在目录中。

summary.en: Core filesystem operations, cloud file services and the desktop file picker address different parts of file handling.
summary.zh: 内核文件操作、云端文件服务与桌面文件选择器分别覆盖文件处理的不同部分。

summary.en: Skills, plugins, MCP and connectors span multiple interfaces. Their shared purpose is a domain grouping, not a single execution chain.
summary.zh: Skills、插件、MCP 和连接器跨越多个接口。共同用途构成领域分组，不代表单一执行链。

summary.en: The core has account and authentication methods; the bundle also contains hosted identity, workspace and billing services.
summary.zh: 内核具有账号与认证方法，发行包还包含托管身份、工作区和计费服务。

summary.en: The wham service contains hosted task and environment interfaces. A protocol counterpart and cloud path may express different stages or alternatives.
summary.zh: wham 服务包含托管任务与环境接口。协议方法与云路径可能表达不同阶段或替代实现。

capabilities.title: Embedded browser and computer use
capabilities.zh: 内嵌浏览器与计算机操作

summary.en: Browser-related IPC and service paths coexist. Browser automation is also represented by core configuration; no claim of universal core absence is made.
summary.zh: 浏览器相关 IPC 与服务路径并存。内核配置也涉及浏览器自动化，不能据此断言内核完全不提供浏览器能力。

summary.en: Window and application integration channels expose Electron responsibilities. Web-rendered controls and native menus remain distinct surfaces.
summary.zh: 窗口与应用集成通道体现 Electron 的职责。Web 控件与原生菜单仍是不同界面。

summary.en: Local protocol configuration, hosted settings and desktop build identity are separate sources of configuration.
summary.zh: 本地协议配置、托管设置和桌面构建身份是不同的配置来源。

summary.en: Protocol feedback, cloud experiment configuration and desktop reporting are grouped by purpose; their traffic is not a single pipeline.
summary.zh: 协议反馈、云端实验配置和桌面报告按用途归组，其流量并非单一管道。

summary.en: Chunked messages, acknowledgements and worker-prefixed channels are transport mechanisms underlying product capabilities.
summary.zh: 消息分块、确认和 worker 前缀通道是支撑产品能力的传输机制。

summary.en: The reference protocol includes Windows sandbox and remote-control methods. Their declaration is not evidence of a corresponding macOS control.
summary.zh: 参考协议包含 Windows 沙箱与远程控制方法。协议声明不证明 macOS 存在对应控件。

summary.en: Hosted memory and personalization paths are indexed here. This grouping does not imply the Rust core has no internal memory-related implementation.
summary.zh: 此处索引托管记忆与个性化路径。该分组不表示 Rust 内核内部没有记忆相关实现。

capabilities.title: Hosted agents and widgets
capabilities.zh: 托管 Agent 与小组件

summary.en: Hosted agent and widget service paths are distinct from local subagent execution; the index records the observed interfaces.
summary.zh: 托管 Agent 与小组件服务路径有别于本地子 Agent 执行，此目录记录已发现的接口。

summary.en: Scheduling service paths and the Scheduled capture are associated by the analysis. No end-to-end scheduling execution was captured in this snapshot.
summary.zh: 分析将定时服务路径与 Scheduled 截图关联。本快照没有定时任务端到端执行证据。

summary.en: Cloud attestation paths are related to the core attestation request. Signing, relay and device ownership require their own call-site evidence.
summary.zh: 云端证明路径与内核证明请求有关联。签名、转发和设备所有权分别需要调用点证据。

summary.en: Pet, promotion and referral paths share hosted service backing. A path in a shared bundle is not proof that a feature is enabled.
summary.zh: 宠物、推广与推荐路径具有托管服务归属。共享包中的路径不证明功能已启用。

fields.name: targetItemId
fields.description:
Identifier for the reviewed item or tool call when one exists.

In most cases, one review maps to one target item. The exceptions are - execve reviews, where a single command may contain multiple execve calls to review (only possible when using the shell_zsh_fork feature) - stdin reviews, which refer to the existing parent command item and have a separate approval ID in the action payload - network policy reviews, where there is no target item

A network call is triggered by a CommandExecution item, so having a target_item_id set to the CommandExecution item would be misleading because the review is about the network call, not the command execution. Therefore, target_item_id is set to None for network policy reviews.

A network call is triggered by a CommandExecution item, so having a target_item_id set to the CommandExecution item would be misleading because the review is about the network call, not the command execution. Therefore, target_item_id is set to None for network policy reviews.

For zsh-exec-bridge subcommand approvals, multiple callbacks can belong to one parent `itemId`, so `approvalId` is a distinct opaque callback id (a UUID) used to disambiguate routing. Stdin approvals also use a distinct callback id; inspect `kind` to distinguish them.

how.zh: 活动会话 → 侧边聊天

summary.en: A thread is the durable unit; turns and items describe work within it. Local and hosted conversations have different execution paths.
summary.zh: 会话是持久单元，轮次和条目描述其中的工作。本地与托管对话具有不同执行路径。

summary.en: Review, terminal, files, browser and side chat live alongside an active conversation. A panel is a UI surface, not an executor.
summary.zh: 审阅、终端、文件、浏览器和侧聊位于活动会话旁侧。面板是界面，并不等同于执行方。

summary.en: Window orchestration and native bridges connect the web-rendered interface to the operating system and subprocesses.
summary.zh: 窗口编排与原生桥将 Web 界面连接到操作系统和子进程。

summary.en: Tasks, agents and schedules have cloud-facing interfaces in the bundle. A captured destination does not prove its full workflow was exercised.
summary.zh: 发行包包含面向云端的任务、Agent 和计划接口。已截取目的地并不表示完整工作流已被验证。

summary.en: Settings combines protocol configuration, account services and OS permissions. Trace each setting to its own boundary.
summary.zh: 设置将协议配置、账号服务与系统权限汇聚在一起，每一项仍有自己的实现边界。

summary.en: The protocol defines thread, turn and item operations. Conversation service paths are grouped alongside them as an analytical comparison, not proof that local threads depend on those paths.
summary.zh: 协议定义会话、轮次和条目操作。conversation 服务路径在分析中与其并列，不构成本地会话依赖这些路径的证据。

summary.en: Core-to-client requests include approvals, user input and attestation. The direction identifies the party expected to answer; it does not establish which UI was displayed.
summary.zh: 内核到客户端的请求包括审批、用户输入和证明。方向标识应答方，不证明展示过哪种 UI。

summary.en: Command and process operations are declared by the core. Platform-specific or absent bundle literals remain visible in the inventory.
summary.zh: 内核声明命令与进程操作。平台专属方法及未命中包内字面量的方法仍保留在目录中。

summary.en: Core filesystem operations, cloud file services and the desktop file picker address different parts of file handling.
summary.zh: 内核文件操作、云端文件服务与桌面文件选择器分别覆盖文件处理的不同部分。

summary.en: Skills, plugins, MCP and connectors span multiple interfaces. Their shared purpose is a domain grouping, not a single execution chain.
summary.zh: Skills、插件、MCP 和连接器跨越多个接口。共同用途构成领域分组，不代表单一执行链。

summary.en: The core has account and authentication methods; the bundle also contains hosted identity, workspace and billing services.
summary.zh: 内核具有账号与认证方法，发行包还包含托管身份、工作区和计费服务。

summary.en: The wham service contains hosted task and environment interfaces. A protocol counterpart and cloud path may express different stages or alternatives.
summary.zh: wham 服务包含托管任务与环境接口。协议方法与云路径可能表达不同阶段或替代实现。

label.zh: 内嵌浏览器与计算机操作

summary.en: Browser-related IPC and service paths coexist. Browser automation is also represented by core configuration; no claim of universal core absence is made.
summary.zh: 浏览器相关 IPC 与服务路径并存。内核配置也涉及浏览器自动化，不能据此断言内核完全不提供浏览器能力。

summary.en: Window and application integration channels expose Electron responsibilities. Web-rendered controls and native menus remain distinct surfaces.
summary.zh: 窗口与应用集成通道体现 Electron 的职责。Web 控件与原生菜单仍是不同界面。

summary.en: Local protocol configuration, hosted settings and desktop build identity are separate sources of configuration.
summary.zh: 本地协议配置、托管设置和桌面构建身份是不同的配置来源。

summary.en: Protocol feedback, cloud experiment configuration and desktop reporting are grouped by purpose; their traffic is not a single pipeline.
summary.zh: 协议反馈、云端实验配置和桌面报告按用途归组，其流量并非单一管道。

summary.en: Chunked messages, acknowledgements and worker-prefixed channels are transport mechanisms underlying product capabilities.
summary.zh: 消息分块、确认和 worker 前缀通道是支撑产品能力的传输机制。

summary.en: The reference protocol includes Windows sandbox and remote-control methods. Their declaration is not evidence of a corresponding macOS control.
summary.zh: 参考协议包含 Windows 沙箱与远程控制方法。协议声明不证明 macOS 存在对应控件。

summary.en: Hosted memory and personalization paths are indexed here. This grouping does not imply the Rust core has no internal memory-related implementation.
summary.zh: 此处索引托管记忆与个性化路径。该分组不表示 Rust 内核内部没有记忆相关实现。

label.zh: 托管 Agent 与小组件

summary.en: Hosted agent and widget service paths are distinct from local subagent execution; the index records the observed interfaces.
summary.zh: 托管 Agent 与小组件服务路径有别于本地子 Agent 执行，此目录记录已发现的接口。

summary.en: Scheduling service paths and the Scheduled capture are associated by the analysis. No end-to-end scheduling execution was captured in this snapshot.
summary.zh: 分析将定时服务路径与 Scheduled 截图关联。本快照没有定时任务端到端执行证据。

summary.en: Cloud attestation paths are related to the core attestation request. Signing, relay and device ownership require their own call-site evidence.
summary.zh: 云端证明路径与内核证明请求有关联。签名、转发和设备所有权分别需要调用点证据。

summary.en: Pet, promotion and referral paths share hosted service backing. A path in a shared bundle is not proof that a feature is enabled.
summary.zh: 宠物、推广与推荐路径具有托管服务归属。共享包中的路径不证明功能已启用。

title.en: Syntax recovers paths that regex misses
title.zh: 语法恢复正则遗漏的路径

body.en: 7 additional paths were recovered from call expressions, including parameterized templates and query strings. The original 343 paths remain individually traceable.
body.zh: 从调用表达式恢复了 7 条新增路径，包括参数模板和查询字符串。原有 343 条路径仍可逐项追踪。

limit.en: These are static client expressions. Live behavior and remote response schemas are not established.
limit.zh: 这些是静态客户端表达式，不证明线上行为或远程响应 Schema。

title.zh: 启动由分阶段交接构成

body.en: The entry .vite/build/early-bootstrap.js has 3 statically resolved imports/requires. Its local dependency path can be followed into the bootstrap and main bundles.
body.zh: 入口 .vite/build/early-bootstrap.js 有 3 条已解析导入／require，可继续追踪到 bootstrap 和 main 包。

limit.en: The graph records static module references, not a timed startup trace.
limit.zh: 该图记录静态模块引用，不是启动计时轨迹。

body.en: 4,343 dynamic import edges occur across 7,262 parsed JavaScript files. They expose deferred boundaries that a filename census cannot describe.
body.zh: 7,262 个成功解析的 JavaScript 文件中发现 4,343 条动态导入边，揭示文件名统计无法描述的延迟边界。

limit.en: An import expression does not prove its branch executes for this account.
limit.zh: 导入表达式不证明其分支在当前账号下执行。

title.en: A path is not a wire destination

body.en: The bundle contains both /backend-api/ and /__codex-api/ references. Inspect the rewrite conditions alongside the main-process handling before attributing a relative request to a host.
body.zh: 发行包同时包含 /backend-api/ 与 /__codex-api/ 引用。应结合改写条件及主进程处理，才能将相对请求归属到主机。

limit.en: Static excerpts establish routing code; they do not prove a request or authentication succeeded.
limit.zh: 静态片段证明路由代码存在，不证明请求或认证成功。

title.en: Chunk names are clues, not a domain model
title.zh: 块名称是线索，不是领域模型

body.en: The largest family by unpacked bytes is “app”. File count and byte share answer different questions. Names alone cannot establish which code is model selection, rendering or agent execution.
body.zh: 按解包字节数最大的族是“app”。文件数与字节占比回答不同问题，单靠名称无法判定模型选择、渲染或 Agent 执行。

limit.en: Families are filename-based classifications. Use import and interface references to test their meaning.
limit.zh: 模块族是按文件名归类的，应结合导入与接口引用检验其含义。

title.zh: 打包具有可测量的重复

body.en: 123 files duplicate an earlier file byte-for-byte (0.68 MB of additional unpacked bytes). Hash equality distinguishes exact duplication from similar names.
body.zh: 123 个文件与此前文件逐字节相同，额外占用 0.68 MB 解包字节。哈希相同可以区分真正重复与名称相似。

limit.en: This is disk representation, not compressed download size or runtime memory use.
limit.zh: 这是磁盘表示，不是压缩下载大小或运行时内存。

title.en: Reachability needs a second kind of proof
title.zh: 可达性需要另一类证据

body.en: 14 bounded examples of named gate-check calls were recovered. Window tokens, gate checks and screenshots represent different observations and remain separate in the model.
body.zh: 提取了 14 个具名开关检查调用的有界示例。窗口令牌、开关检查与截图属于不同观测，在模型中分别记录。

limit.en: Minified aliases and server-delivered flags are outside this named-call inventory. No gate value is inferred.
limit.zh: 压缩别名与服务端下发开关不在此具名调用清单内，不推断开关取值。

title.en: Native integration is an explicit boundary
title.zh: 原生集成具有明确边界

body.en: The package declares native and bridge dependencies alongside app-server-manager, browser and git workers. Follow require/import edges to distinguish a declared dependency from an actual reference.
body.zh: 包清单声明了原生桥、app-server-manager、浏览器与 Git worker 依赖。继续追踪 require／import 边，区分依赖声明与实际引用。

limit.en: Package declarations do not prove a permission was granted or a native operation ran.
limit.zh: 包声明不证明权限已授予或原生操作已运行。

summary.en: A protocol-guided reading, not a captured execution trace.
summary.zh: 依据协议的阅读路径，不是已捕获的执行轨迹。

body.en: The archived conversation capture identifies a user-visible surface. Its relationship to the protocol is an analytical mapping.
body.zh: 归档会话截图标识用户可见的界面，其与协议的关系属于分析映射。

body.en: thread/start declares the input configuration and returns the thread record. Inspect the Rust definition and parameter fields.
body.zh: thread/start 声明输入配置并返回会话记录，可查看 Rust 定义及参数字段。

body.en: turn/start supplies input for work within a thread. This separates durable conversation state from one unit of execution.
body.zh: turn/start 为会话内的一轮工作提供输入，将持久会话状态与单次执行单元分开。

body.en: Server notifications report item deltas and completion. Their direction is core → client.
body.zh: 服务端通知报告条目增量与完成状态，方向为内核 → 客户端。

title.en: A decision requested by the core

summary.en: Request direction explains the boundary; the exact desktop surface remains separately evidenced.
summary.zh: 请求方向解释边界，具体桌面界面另有证据。

body.en: A server request asks the client for a decision. Read the declared request payload.
body.zh: 服务端请求向客户端征求决策，可查看其声明的请求载荷。

body.en: The schema records decision alternatives. A protocol alternative does not prove which branch was selected.
body.zh: Schema 记录可选决策；某个选项存在并不证明该分支被选择。

body.en: The response answers the outstanding request. This walkthrough is descriptive and does not execute commands.
body.zh: 响应回答待处理请求。本解读用于描述，不执行命令。

summary.en: Follow code references across routing boundaries; unresolved wire behavior stays visible.
summary.zh: 跨越路由边界追踪代码引用，同时保留线上行为的未决部分。

body.en: A get/post-style call supplies a relative path and arguments. A call-shaped expression is static evidence, not network telemetry.
body.zh: get／post 风格调用提供相对路径与参数。调用表达式是静态证据，并非网络遥测。

body.en: Inspect /__codex-api/ and /backend-api/ references together with their conditions.
body.zh: 结合条件阅读 /__codex-api/ 与 /backend-api/ 引用。

body.en: The main-process code carries routing and host references. This is where the renderer and remote service boundaries meet.
body.zh: 主进程代码包含路由与主机引用，渲染层与远程服务边界在这里交汇。

body.en: Response schemas, live host selection and authorization results require evidence beyond a static client call.
body.zh: 响应 Schema、实际主机选择和授权结果需要静态客户端调用以外的证据。

summary.en: A static reading of module hand-offs and interface boundaries.
summary.zh: 对模块交接与接口边界的静态解读。

body.en: The package entry loads its bootstrap dependencies before the main application module.
body.zh: 包入口先加载引导依赖，再进入主应用模块。

body.en: Preload code exposes or forwards desktop messages. Read the channel and operation together.
body.zh: Preload 代码暴露或转发桌面消息，应同时查看通道与操作。

body.en: The Electron side hosts window, worker and native integration responsibilities.
body.zh: Electron 侧承载窗口、worker 与原生集成职责。

body.en: App-server references connect desktop orchestration to the Rust protocol. Exact binary-to-source revision matching remains unverified.
body.zh: App-server 引用连接桌面编排与 Rust 协议，二进制与源码的精确版本匹配仍未验证。
